_doc: Engine glue for the translated WaW in-game menus (wawmenu.py, waw_menu.lua). Each entry names the T4 engine state a menu reads or the engine menu it opens, and the T6 equivalent with its reason. Nothing here is a game rule.

options_new_pc.reason: WaW's options tree edits T4 engine settings (r_*, snd_*, bindings); T6 has its own renderer, sound and binding settings, so OPTIONS opens T6's settings menu.

dvars.zombiemode: 1: the converted level is a zombies map (T4 sets it before loading one).
dvars.mapname: the source WaW map name (menu_map_<map>, the HAS_INGAME_MAP test).
dvars.sv_running: T6 sv_running: this client hosts the level.
dvars.onlinegame: T6 session is neither offline nor system link.
dvars.xblive_privatematch: T6 GAMEMODE_PRIVATE_MATCH in an online session.
dvars.credits_active: empty: T6 has no credits level.

leave_commands._reason: T6's in-game menu clears cl_paused before a command that leaves or restarts the level (RestartGamePopup, EndGamePopup).
